name: University of Cambridge
typicalOffer: A*A*A, Mathematics plus 2 other science or mathematics subjects (Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and for A level only Further Mathematics); some Colleges/first-year options need specific sciences
notes: Natural Sciences (Physical) with astrophysics specialisation; access to Institute of Astronomy; NSAA required

name: University of Oxford
typicalOffer: A*AA, including Mathematics and Physics; the A* must be in Mathematics, Physics or Further Mathematics
notes: Physics MPhys with astrophysics specialisation in Years 3-4; access to Oxford Astrophysics group; entrance test required

name: Durham University
typicalOffer: A*A*A, including Physics and Mathematics; science A levels with a practical component require the practical to be passed
notes: No course under the listed title; this is the university’s closest course in the subject.

name: University College London
typicalOffer: A*AA, A*A in Mathematics and Physics (any order)
notes: 4-year MPhys Astrophysics; UCL Mullard Space Science Laboratory — largest UK university space research group; major ESA collaborations

name: University of Manchester
typicalOffer: A*A*A, including A* in Physics and A* in Mathematics or Further Mathematics
notes: 4-year MPhys Astrophysics; Jodrell Bank Observatory — world-leading radio telescope on campus; strong gravitational wave research

name: University of St Andrews
typicalOffer: AAA, including A in both Mathematics and Physics
notes: 4-year MPhys Astrophysics; access to Scottish dark-sky sites; strong solar physics and exoplanet research; Scottish 4-year Honours

name: Cardiff University
typicalOffer: AAA-ABB, including grade B in Maths and Physics (Maths without Physics considered, normally with grade A in Maths); science practical must be passed
notes: 4-year MPhys Astrophysics; Cardiff is a key LIGO gravitational wave node; strong observational and theoretical astrophysics

name: University of Nottingham
typicalOffer: AAA, Including AA in A level maths and physics
notes: 4-year MPhys Astrophysics; access to university observatory; strong planetary science and galactic dynamics research

name: University of Edinburgh
typicalOffer: AAA-ABB, including Mathematics at A and Physics at B
notes: No course under the listed title; this is the university’s closest course in the subject.

name: University of Sheffield
typicalOffer: AAA, including Maths and Physics + pass in the practical element of any science A Levels taken
notes: 4-year MPhys Astrophysics; strong links to space science industry; Sheffield Astronomy group; access to national telescope facilities

name: University of Southampton
typicalOffer: A*AA-AAA, including physics (minimum grade A) and either mathematics or further mathematics (minimum grade A)
notes: Physics with Astrophysics option via MPhys; Southampton Astronomy Group; major ESA collaborations; UK space hub university

name: University of Birmingham
typicalOffer: A*AA or AAAA, including A-level Mathematics and Physics at grades A*A (or AA as part of the four A-level offer)
notes: No course under the listed title; this is the university’s closest course in the subject.

name: University of Leeds
typicalOffer: AAA, including Physics and Mathematics; pass in practical science element where an A-level science is taken
notes: 4-year MPhys Astrophysics; strong observational and theoretical astrophysics; links to National Centre for Atmospheric Science

name: Keele University
typicalOffer: ABB, including B in Maths or in Physics
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MPhys Astrophysics; Keele Observatory on campus; accessible entry requirements; strong student-to-staff ratio

name: University of Hertfordshire
typicalOffer: BBB, B in Maths, B in Physics
notes: 3-year BSc Astrophysics; close to Airbus Defence and ESA-ESTEC; accessible entry requirements; observatory on campus; good for space sector starters
